lists: Built-in List Bullet and List Number styles, with custom OOXML only for lettered and roman lists, because built-in styles are decimal only. Cost: detection reads text prefixes, so prose that starts like a list can be misread.
fonts: A static fallback table instead of probing installed fonts, so it needs no OS access. Cost: a font name the table does not know becomes Arial, and only body paragraphs are touched, not tables.
